Definition: Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Michael is the archangel, the great prince who stands for the children of God's people, and Daniel's visions are where he appears. He came to help the angel who was withstood by the prince of Persia, he alone held with the messenger in the things of the prophecy, and at the time of the end he shall stand up for Daniel's people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Michael is the proof that the war is real and the help is real: princes of darkness withstand God's messengers, and the chief prince stands for us.
